seoTitle: Olentangy Schools Calendar: Dates & Cohort Guides
seoDescription: Reviewed Olentangy Schools calendars for Lewis Center and Delaware County, with K–12 dates, kindergarten cohorts, preschool schedules, breaks, and official PDFs.
districtFact: Olentangy Schools coordinates 27 K–12 schools across a 95-square-mile service area that lies mostly in Delaware County and reaches a small part of Franklin County. The district calendar is the shared layer for families in multiple townships and the cities of Delaware, Columbus, Westerville, and Powell.
profileDisclaimer: The 27-school count covers 17 elementary schools, six middle schools, and four high schools listed by the district. It excludes the preschool program, Olentangy Academy, and OASIS. Enrollment is the exact preschool-through-grade-12 total in the May 6, 2026 official report. Building events, athletics, emergency changes, and program schedules can add dates beyond the district PDFs.

about.title: One Headline Calendar, Three Attendance Patterns
about.content: The district PDF sets the common K–12 framework, but it is not the only calendar a family may need. Kindergarten follows two color-coded attendance cohorts with assigned Wednesdays, while preschool generally meets Tuesday through Friday and publishes its own first day, last day, conference dates, and program events.

about.title: The Last-Day Early Release Is K–5 Only
about.content: Olentangy's final student day includes a two-hour early dismissal for kindergarten through grade 5. Middle and high school families should not automatically apply that shortened-day rule to their students.

about.title: Conference Exchange Days Close School Districtwide
about.content: A Conference Exchange Day on the district calendar is a no-school day for students. Preschool's separately printed, site-specific conference appointments are different: they identify family meeting dates and should not be read as an extra districtwide closure unless the preschool calendar also marks no school.

about.title: Curriculum Nights and Graduations Live on a Separate Sheet
about.content: Olentangy publishes a School Events Calendar alongside the attendance calendar. It adds grade-banded curriculum nights, grade-due and report-card dates, and four high-school graduation time blocks that are not printed on the main district calendar.

about.title: A 95-Square-Mile Central Ohio Footprint
about.content: The district says its territory is primarily in Delaware County with a small southern portion in Franklin County. It serves all or parts of Orange, Berkshire, Berlin, Concord, Genoa, Liberty, and Delaware townships and parts of Delaware, Columbus, Westerville, and Powell.

about.title: Growth Is Visible in the Calendar Network
about.content: The May 6, 2026 enrollment report counts 23,889 K–12 students and 674 preschool students. Coordinating 24,563 learners across elementary, middle, high-school, preschool, academy, and alternative settings is why the district maintains distinct calendar layers instead of forcing every program into one page.

about.title: Bell Times Are Tiered by School
about.content: All four high schools use a 7:20 a.m. start, but middle schools are split among three schedules and elementary schools use two start groups. Olentangy Academy and OASIS also publish separate times, so a districtwide date never implies a districtwide bell time.

calendarNotes: Use the district calendar for K–12 closures and broad school-year boundaries. Kindergarten families must also use the color-cohort calendar because the first attendance date and assigned Wednesdays differ by cohort. Preschool families need the separate Tuesday–Friday calendar, whose August start and May ending differ from K–12. A Conference Exchange Day on the district calendar means no school, while preschool site conferences are appointments rather than automatic districtwide closures. The School Events Calendar adds curriculum nights, report-card milestones, and high-school graduation times. The two-hour early dismissal on the final K–12 day applies only to grades K–5. Individual school calendars remain necessary for athletics, performances, testing, and emergency revisions.

planningTips.title: Planning with the Olentangy Schools Calendar
content: Start with the district calendar, then add the kindergarten or preschool PDF if your child follows one of those program tracks.
For kindergarten, confirm whether your child is in the Monday/Thursday or Tuesday/Friday color group and keep the assigned Wednesday dates from the cohort PDF.
For preschool, plan around a Tuesday–Friday attendance week and verify site-specific conference appointments at ACES, AES, PCES, OPCC, OSP, SMES, or WRES.
Treat Conference Exchange Days as student no-school days, but do not turn every preschool conference entry into a closure.
On the final K–12 day, use the two-hour early-dismissal notice only for grades K–5.
Check the School Events Calendar for curriculum nights, report-card availability, and the separate ceremony time for each high school.
An ICS download is a one-time copy; revisit the official calendar hub after weather closures or a Board-approved revision.

livingHere.intro: Olentangy Schools serves a fast-growing, multi-community area north of Columbus, where one district calendar crosses municipal and township boundaries.

highlights.label: 95 square miles
highlights.detail: The attendance area spans multiple Delaware County townships and a small part of Franklin County.

highlights.label: 24,563 students
highlights.detail: The May 6, 2026 district report totals 23,889 K–12 students and 674 preschool students.

highlights.label: 27 K–12 schools
highlights.detail: The official school lists include 17 elementary schools, six middle schools, and four high schools.

highlights.label: Four high schools
highlights.detail: Olentangy, Liberty, Orange, and Berlin each receive a separate graduation time on the School Events Calendar.

highlights.label: Consolidation roots
highlights.detail: The district history traces consolidation from one-room schools beginning in 1911, with a consolidated school built in 1952.

highlights.label: Tiered daily schedules
highlights.detail: Elementary and middle schools use multiple start groups, while specialized programs publish their own hours.

districtFaqs.q: Do all Olentangy students use the same calendar?
districtFaqs.a: No. The district calendar is the K–12 baseline, but kindergarten uses two attendance cohorts and preschool has a separate Tuesday–Friday calendar. The School Events Calendar adds curriculum and reporting dates.

districtFaqs.q: Do Olentangy kindergarten students attend every weekday?
districtFaqs.a: Not according to the 2026–27 kindergarten calendar. One cohort attends Monday and Thursday, the other Tuesday and Friday, and Wednesdays are assigned by the color shown on the official calendar.
The 2026–27 preschool parent calendar marks regular attendance Tuesday through Friday, beginning August 25, 2026 and ending May 26, 2027.

districtFaqs.q: Does Olentangy's last-day early dismissal apply to every grade?
districtFaqs.a: No. The district calendar says the two-hour early dismissal applies to kindergarten through grade 5.

districtFaqs.q: Are preschool conference dates no-school days for all Olentangy students?
districtFaqs.a: No. Preschool conference dates are site-specific appointments. Districtwide no-school days are separately identified on the district or preschool calendar.

districtFaqs.q: Where are Olentangy high-school graduation times published?
districtFaqs.a: The separate School Events Calendar lists graduation time blocks for Olentangy, Liberty, Orange, and Berlin high schools.

districtFaqs.q: Why is there no official 2025–26 PDF download on this site?
districtFaqs.a: The available local file was generated by a third party and is not an official district PDF. The 2025–26 page therefore uses verified events from Olentangy's official historical web calendar and does not present that file as an official download.
